metrics.note: Report-only pause probe (design §3) with a phase-scoped sweep window: in-window means the resolve started while the sweeper had the flag armed around FlowTable.RemoveExpired, so maxSweepWindowPauseMs (acceptance figure, research's 0.5 ms line) and the pausesInWindow* counts exclude the scenario's own refill contention. The raw maxPauseMs / pausesOver* series stay report-only and are quoted normalized per sweep: at least 96% of those pauses are the 65,536 per-round refill claims contending on the same table gate, at most 4 observers x ~141 sweeps can be sweep-sourced. sweepWindowResolves proves the window is not vacuous. The exact gate is the sweep's zero allocation, asserted in SweepAllocationGateTests.
